description: Get current account balance (percent of GDP) from the IMF World Economic Outlook (WEO) for one or more countries, including IMF forward projections. Filter by ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code(s) and/or a year range; omit filters to get all 190+ countries plus regional/income-group aggregates. Data: IMF DataMapper (www.imf.org), CC BY 4.0, no auth required.

countries.description: List of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes to filter (e.g. ["USA","DEU","JPN"]), max 20. Use instead of "country" to fetch multiple countries in one call.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code to filter (e.g. "USA", "DEU", "JPN", "CHN"). Omit to return all 190+ countries plus IMF regional/income-group aggregates.

end_year.description: Latest year to include, including IMF WEO forward projections (e.g. 2029). Omit for full history.

start_year.description: Earliest year to include in the returned time series (e.g. 2015). Omit for full history.

name: imf.macro.current_account

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Get IMF Current Account Balance
